name: Axis
description: Represents a single axis in a chart.
remarks: The Axis object is a member of the Axes collection. Use Axes (_type_, _group_), where _type_ is the axis type and _group_ is the axis group, to return a single Axis object. - _Type_ can be one of the following XlAxisType constants: xlCategory, xlSeriesAxis, or xlValue. - _Group_ can be one of the following XlAxisGroup constants: xlPrimary or xlSecondary. For more information, see the Axes method of the Chart object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: AxisBetweenCategories
properties.description: True if the value axis crosses the category axis between categories. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AxisGroup
properties.description: Returns the group for the specified axis. Read-only.

properties.name: AxisTitle
properties.description: Returns an AxisTitle object that represents the title of the specified axis. Read-only.

properties.name: Border
properties.description: Returns a Border object that represents the border of the object.

properties.name: CategoryNames
properties.description: Returns or sets all the category names for the specified axis as a text array. When you set this property, you can set it to either an array or a Range object that contains the category names. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Crosses
properties.description: Returns or sets the point on the specified axis where the other axis crosses. Read/write Long.

properties.name: CrossesAt
properties.description: Returns or sets the point on the value axis where the category axis crosses it. Applies only to the value axis. Read/write Double.

properties.name: HasMajorGridlines
properties.description: True if the axis has major gridlines. Only axes in the primary axis group can have gridlines. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasMinorGridlines
properties.description: True if the axis has minor gridlines. Only axes in the primary axis group can have gridlines. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasTitle
properties.description: True if the axis or chart has a visible title. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MajorGridlines
properties.description: Returns a Gridlines object that represents the major gridlines for the specified axis. Only axes in the primary axis group can have gridlines. Read-only.

properties.name: MajorTickMark
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of major tick mark for the specified axis. Read/write XlTickMark.

properties.name: MajorUnit
properties.description: Returns or sets the major units for the value axis. Read/write Double.

properties.name: MajorUnitIsAuto
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel calculates the major units for the value axis. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MaximumScale
properties.description: Returns or sets the maximum value on the value axis. Read/write Double.

properties.name: MaximumScaleIsAuto
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel calculates the maximum value for the value axis. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MinimumScale
properties.description: Returns or sets the minimum value on the value axis. Read/write Double.

properties.name: MinimumScaleIsAuto
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel calculates the minimum value for the value axis. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MinorGridlines
properties.description: Returns a Gridlines object that represents the minor gridlines for the specified axis. Only axes in the primary axis group can have gridlines. Read-only.

properties.name: MinorTickMark
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of minor tick mark for the specified axis. Read/write XlTickMark.

properties.name: MinorUnit
properties.description: Returns or sets the minor units on the value axis. Read/write Double.

properties.name: MinorUnitIsAuto
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel calculates minor units for the value axis. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ReversePlotOrder
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel plots data points from last to first. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ScaleType
properties.description: Returns or sets the value axis scale type. Read/write XlScaleType.

properties.name: TickLabelPosition
properties.description: Describes the position of tick-mark labels on the specified axis. Read/write XlTickLabelPosition.

properties.name: TickLabels
properties.description: Returns a TickLabels object that represents the tick-mark labels for the specified axis. Read-only.

properties.name: TickLabelSpacing
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of categories or series between tick-mark labels. Applies only to category and series axes. Can be a value from 1 through 31999. Read/write Long.

properties.name: TickMarkSpacing
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of categories or series between tick marks. Applies only to category and series axes. Can be a value from 1 through 31999. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns an XlAxisType value that represents the Axis type.

properties.name: BaseUnit
properties.description: Returns or sets the base unit for the specified category axis. Read/write XlTimeUnit.

properties.name: BaseUnitIsAuto
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel chooses appropriate base units for the specified category axis. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MajorUnitScale
properties.description: Returns or sets the major unit scale value for the category axis when the CategoryType property is set to xlTimeScale. Read/write XlTimeUnit.

properties.name: MinorUnitScale
properties.description: Returns or sets the minor unit scale value for the category axis when the CategoryType property is set to xlTimeScale. Read/write XlTimeUnit.

properties.name: CategoryType
properties.description: Returns or sets the category axis type. Read/write XlCategoryType.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of the object to the left edge of the chart area.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the top edge of the object to the top of row 1 (on a worksheet) or the top of the chart area (on a chart).

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns a Double value that represents the width, in points, of the object.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns a Double value that represents the height, in points, of the object.

properties.name: DisplayUnit
properties.description: Returns or sets the unit label for the value axis. Read/write XlDisplayUnit, xlCustom, or xlNone.

properties.name: DisplayUnitCustom
properties.description: If the value of the DisplayUnit property is xlCustom, the DisplayUnitCustom property returns or sets the value of the displayed units. The value must be from 0 through 10E307. Read/write Double.

properties.name: HasDisplayUnitLabel
properties.description: True if the label specified by the DisplayUnit or DisplayUnitCustom property is displayed on the specified axis. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayUnitLabel
properties.description: Returns the DisplayUnitLabel object for the specified axis. Returns null if the HasDisplayUnitLabel property is set to False. Read-only.

properties.name: LogBase
properties.description: Returns or sets the base of the logarithm when you are using log scales. Read/write Double.

properties.name: TickLabelSpacingIsAuto
properties.description: Returns or sets whether or not the tick label spacing is automatic. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns the ChartFormat object. Read-only.

methods.name: SetProperty
methods.signature: SetProperty(ID As String, Value As Variant)
